Kaden Cassidy is an "Applied Mathematics in Computation" major at Harvey Mudd College. He works in the VLSI Lab
as a Clay-Wolken fellow where he is creating the next generation of ceritifcation and hardware implementation
of the RISCV Vector Extension for RISCV processors. He also competes for the CMS Track & Field team in the hammer,
shotput and discus throw.
